'''Izumi Shrine''' (泉神社) refers to several {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}} across Japan.

* {{ill|Izumi Shrine (Hitachi)|ja|泉神社 (日立市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Izumi Shrine (Hitachi)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11554897}} (Hitachi City, Ibaraki Prefecture) - A {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|延喜式神名帳}} small shrine. The {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|en|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines}} categorized it as a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}{{efn|District Shrines|qid=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917316|qq= 近代社格制度}}.
* {{ill|Izumi Shrine (Maibara)|ja|泉神社 (米原市)}} (Maibara City, Shiga Prefecture)
* {{ill|Izumi Shrine (Usa)|ja|泉神社 (宇佐市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Izumi Shrine (Usa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135579316}} (Usa City, Oita Prefecture) - Formerly classified as a Gōsha.
